g.text: WebMorph discovery pipeline: evidence in, validated tools out
Deterministic discovery · HTTP only, no browser, no model
Browser evidence · Playwright behind the policy proxy, read-only probes
Website model · deterministic first; facts cite evidence, hypotheses cite facts
Tools · data, not code; API first; validated against the live site before publishing
SSRF check of the start host
or every route for SPA shells
Every artifact is immutable per job and carries an envelope: schema version, site and job IDs, producing stage,
source artifacts, provenance. Stages talk only through artifacts, so a job can be inspected, resumed and diffed.
